subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on August 15th, 2022. Your departure time is at 10:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please arrive at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, Airline Customer Service
